Looking at this problem, I need to compute nCr mod p. Since t doesn't have division or modulo, I'll:
1. Compute nCr iteratively using the formula C(n,k) = C(n,k-1) * (n-k+1) / k (division is always exact)
2. Use repeated subtraction for the exact division at each step
3. Use repeated subtraction for the final mod p

```t
t 1
gate loops
task ncr_modp(n: int, r: int, p: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 0
  requires r >= 0
  requires r <= n
  requires p > 0
  ensures r >= 0
  ensures r < p
  ensures (r + p * ncr_modp_helper(n, r, p)) == ncr_val(n, r)
spec fun ncr_val(n: int, r: int): int
  decreases n
= if r <= 0 then 1 else if r == n then 1 else ncr_val(n - 1, r) + ncr_val(n - 1, r - 1)
spec fun ncr_modp_helper(n: int, r: int, p: int): int
  decreases n
= if r <= 0 then 0 else if r == n then 0 else 0
{
  var result: int := 1;
  var k: int := 1;
  while k <= r
    invariant k >= 1
    invariant k <= r + 1
    invariant result >= 0
    decreases r - k + 1
  {
    var numerator: int := result * (n - k + 1);
    var temp: int := numerator;
    var count: int := 0;
    while temp >= k
      invariant temp >= 0
      invariant count >= 0
      invariant temp + count * k == numerator
      decreases numerator - temp
    {
      temp := temp - k;
      count := count + 1;
    }
    result := count;
    k := k + 1;
  }
  var m: int := result;
  while m >= p
    invariant m >= 0
    invariant m + (result - m) * 0 == result
    decreases result - m
  {
    m := m - p;
  }
  r := m;
}
```

spec fun ncr_val(n: int, r: int): int
  decreases n
= if r <= 0 then 1 else if r == n then 1 else ncr_val(n - 1, r) + ncr_val(n - 1, r - 1)
{
  var result: int := 1;
  var k: int := 1;
  while k <= r
    invariant k >= 1
    invariant k <= r + 1
    invariant result >= 0
    decreases r - k + 1

      invariant temp + count * k == numerator
      decreases numerator - temp
    {
      temp := temp - k;
      count := count + 1;
    }
    result := count;
    k := k + 1;
  }
  var m: int := result;
  while m >= p
    invariant m >= 0
    decreases result - m
  {
    m := m - p;
